blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 EU Annex 1 的 Grade A/B/C/D 潔淨室分級與對應的微生物行動標準（Action Levels）
blocks.en: Understand the EU Annex 1 Grade A/B/C/D cleanroom classification and the corresponding microbial action levels

blocks.zh: 掌握各等級區域（Grade A 至 D）對清潔劑、消毒劑與孢子殺菌劑（Sporicide）的選用原則
blocks.en: Master the principles for selecting cleaning agents, disinfectants and sporicides for each grade (Grade A to D)

blocks.zh: 說明 Grade A/B 區域清潔的最高要求：無菌抹布、工具滅菌入場、單向擦拭技術
blocks.en: Explain the most stringent cleaning requirements for Grade A/B areas: sterile wipers, sterilized tools brought into the area, and unidirectional wiping technique

blocks.zh: 比較三種施藥方式（噴霧擦拭 Spray-and-wipe、拖把 Mop、浸泡 Soak/Immersion）的適用場合與操作要點
blocks.en: Compare the applications and key operating points of the three application methods (spray-and-wipe, mop, soak/immersion)

blocks.zh: 識別常見稽核缺失：所用消毒劑與區域等級不符，以及清潔 SOP 未明確規定藥劑濃度、接觸時間與抹布種類
blocks.en: Recognize common audit findings: the disinfectant used does not match the area grade, and the cleaning SOP does not specify agent concentration, contact time or wiper type

blocks.zh: 本節內容 Contents
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: 區域分級總覽
blocks.en: Overview of Area Classification

blocks.zh: 受控環境（Controlled Environment）的潔淨室分級，以懸浮微粒數為主要依據，目前並行三套標準：
blocks.en: Cleanroom classification of controlled environments is based mainly on airborne particle counts, and three standards currently run in parallel:

blocks.zh: 美國聯邦標準 209E——1999 年已廢止，僅供歷史比對
blocks.en: US Federal Standard 209E - withdrawn in 1999; used for historical comparison only

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1（歐盟 GMP 附則一）——定義 Grade A、B、C、D 四級，為無菌製造最廣泛引用的標準
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 (Annex 1 of the EU GMP Guidelines) - defines four grades, A, B, C and D; the most widely cited standard for sterile manufacturing

blocks.zh: ISO 14644——定義 ISO Class 5–8，與 EU Annex 1 可對照換算
blocks.en: ISO 14644 - defines ISO Class 5-8, which can be cross-referenced to EU Annex 1

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何分級決定清潔策略？
blocks.en: Core concept: why does grade determine the cleaning strategy?

blocks.zh: 各等級代表不同的微生物污染風險：Grade A 直接暴露於無菌製程（Aseptic Process），任何微生物污染均可能造成產品不合格；Grade D 為一般支援區，風險相對最低。清潔劑類型、使用頻率及施藥方法，必須與風險等級相符。
blocks.en: Each grade represents a different level of microbial contamination risk. Grade A is directly exposed to the aseptic process, so any microbial contamination can render the product unacceptable; Grade D is a general support area with the lowest relative risk. The type of cleaning agent, the frequency of use and the application method must match the risk level.

blocks.zh: 比喻：好比手術室到倉庫
blocks.en: Analogy: from the operating room to the warehouse

blocks.zh: Grade A 相當於「手術台正上方」，Grade D 相當於「醫院倉庫走廊」——同一棟建築，但清潔要求截然不同。用倉庫等級的消毒劑去清潔手術台，是典型的稽核缺失。
blocks.en: Grade A is like "directly above the operating table" and Grade D is like "the hospital warehouse corridor" - the same building, but very different cleaning requirements. Cleaning the operating table with a warehouse-grade disinfectant is a classic audit finding.

blocks.zh: 表 9.1-2：微生物行動標準（Active Air Sampling）
blocks.en: Table 9.1-2: Microbial Action Levels (Active Air Sampling)

blocks.zh: 數據來源：EU Annex 1、PIC/S、WHO Annex 4（沉降菌數另有標準）
blocks.en: Data sources: EU Annex 1, PIC/S, WHO Annex 4 (settle plate counts have separate limits)

blocks.zh: 為何清潔必須在消毒前進行？
blocks.en: Why must cleaning be performed before disinfection?

blocks.zh: 清潔（Cleaning）並非消毒（Disinfection）的替代步驟，而是前置必要條件。殘留的有機物（產品殘跡、微粒）會：
blocks.en: Cleaning is not a substitute for disinfection; it is a necessary prerequisite. Residual organic matter (product residues, particles) will:

blocks.zh: 保護微生物免受消毒劑接觸
blocks.en: Shield microorganisms from contact with the disinfectant

blocks.zh: 與消毒劑的活性成分發生化學干擾，降低殺菌效力
blocks.en: Interfere chemically with the active ingredient of the disinfectant, reducing its antimicrobial efficacy

blocks.zh: 乾燥後剝落，重新釋放至環境中
blocks.en: Flake off once dry and be released back into the environment

blocks.zh: 關鍵操作要點：接觸時間（Contact Time / Wet Time）
blocks.en: Key operating point: contact time (wet time)

blocks.zh: 消毒劑需在表面保持濕潤狀態，才能讓活性成分滲透微生物細胞壁。Grade A/B 區域採用單向氣流（Unidirectional Airflow, UDAF），氣流速度快，表面乾燥極迅速——SOP 必須明確規定接觸時間，並考慮氣流對蒸發速率的影響。
blocks.en: The disinfectant must keep the surface wet so that the active ingredient can penetrate the microbial cell wall. Grade A/B areas use unidirectional airflow (UDAF); the airflow velocity is high and surfaces dry extremely quickly. The SOP must specify the contact time explicitly and take into account the effect of airflow on the evaporation rate.

blocks.zh: 清潔頻率的決定因素
blocks.en: Factors that determine cleaning frequency

blocks.zh: 區域等級——等級越高，頻率越高
blocks.en: Area grade - the higher the grade, the higher the frequency

blocks.zh: 使用強度——批次數量、換班次數
blocks.en: Intensity of use - number of batches, number of shift changes

blocks.zh: 風險評估——產品暴露程度
blocks.en: Risk assessment - degree of product exposure

blocks.zh: 目視清潔狀態——可見污染立即觸發清潔
blocks.en: Visual cleanliness - visible contamination immediately triggers cleaning

blocks.zh: Grade A / B 區域清潔要求
blocks.en: Cleaning Requirements for Grade A / B Areas

blocks.zh: Grade A — 無菌製程核心區
blocks.en: Grade A - the core zone of the aseptic process

blocks.zh: Grade A 即 EU Annex 1 最高等級，對應 ISO Class 5。典型場所：灌裝工作站（Filling Zone）、層流罩（LAF, Laminar Air Flow）、RABS 或隔離器（Isolator）內部。
blocks.en: Grade A is the highest grade in EU Annex 1 and corresponds to ISO Class 5. Typical locations: filling zone, laminar air flow (LAF) hood, and the interior of RABS or isolators.

blocks.zh: Grade A 清潔六大要件：
blocks.en: Six key elements of Grade A cleaning:

blocks.zh: 無菌抹布（Sterile Wipers）——必須使用已滅菌的低落絮（Low-lint）不織布抹布，不得使用一般紙巾或棉布
blocks.en: Sterile wipers - sterilized, low-lint non-woven wipers must be used; ordinary paper towels or cotton cloths are not permitted

blocks.zh: 工具滅菌入場——所有清潔器具（拖把桿、水桶、刮水器）使用前必須完成滅菌，並記錄
blocks.en: Sterilized tools brought into the area - all cleaning implements (mop handles, buckets, squeegees) must be sterilized before use, and this must be recorded

blocks.zh: 孢子殺菌劑（Sporicide）——如汽化過氧化氫（VHP）、過氧乙酸（Peracetic Acid, PAA）、二氧化氯（ClO₂）。一般消毒劑無法殺滅芽孢，Grade A 必須定期使用孢子殺菌劑
blocks.en: Sporicide - such as vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VHP), peracetic acid (PAA) or chlorine dioxide (ClO₂). General disinfectants cannot kill spores, so Grade A requires periodic use of a sporicide

blocks.zh: 不使用拖把直接拖地——LAF 下方地板通常以 VHP 氣化循環或人工無菌擦拭處理
blocks.en: No direct mopping of floors - the floor beneath the LAF is usually treated with a VHP gassing cycle or manual sterile wiping

blocks.zh: 單向重疊擦拭技術——由內向外、由上向下，每次擦拭重疊 30%，避免交叉污染
blocks.en: Unidirectional overlapping wiping technique - from the inside out and from top to bottom, overlapping each stroke by 30% to avoid cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 人員資格——執行 Grade A 清潔的人員需完成無菌區域更衣培訓與媒體充填（Media Fill）資格確認
blocks.en: Personnel qualification - personnel performing Grade A cleaning must have completed aseptic gowning training and media fill qualification

blocks.zh: 比喻：外科手術刷手規程
blocks.en: Analogy: the surgical scrub procedure

blocks.zh: Grade A 清潔就像外科刷手——每一個步驟、每一個方向都有嚴格規範，因為任何疏失都直接影響病患安全（產品無菌性）。「差不多」不存在於這個等級。
blocks.en: Grade A cleaning is like a surgical scrub - every step and every direction is strictly prescribed, because any lapse directly affects patient safety (product sterility). "Close enough" does not exist at this grade.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：TWi 無菌灌裝廠
blocks.en: CDMO practice: TWi sterile filling facility

blocks.zh: TWi 的 Grade A/B 區域（無菌灌裝線）屬最高風險等級，清潔 SOP 必須明確載明：藥劑名稱、有效濃度、接觸時間、抹布類型與批號、清潔順序及操作人員資格。稽核常見缺失之一：使用的消毒劑與區域等級不符（如 Grade A 僅使用一般消毒劑而未定期施用孢子殺菌劑）。
blocks.en: TWi's Grade A/B areas (aseptic filling lines) are the highest-risk grades, and the cleaning SOP must clearly state: agent name, effective concentration, contact time, wiper type and lot number, cleaning sequence and operator qualification. One common audit finding is a disinfectant that does not match the area grade (for example, using only a general disinfectant in Grade A without periodically applying a sporicide).

blocks.zh: Grade C / D 區域清潔要求
blocks.en: Cleaning Requirements for Grade C / D Areas

blocks.zh: Grade C — 二級支援區域
blocks.en: Grade C - secondary support area

blocks.zh: Grade C（對應 ISO Class 8 靜態）典型場所：溶液配製室（Solution Preparation）、元件準備室、部分灌裝前工序。雖非直接接觸最終無菌產品，仍屬受控環境，需要系統性的消毒計畫。
blocks.en: Grade C (equivalent to ISO Class 8 at rest) is typically used for solution preparation rooms, component preparation rooms and some pre-filling operations. Although it does not come into direct contact with the final sterile product, it is still a controlled environment and requires a systematic disinfection program.

blocks.zh: Grade C 清潔計畫重點：
blocks.en: Key points of a Grade C cleaning program:

blocks.zh: 消毒劑輪替（Disinfectant Rotation）——定期交替使用兩種以上化學機制不同的消毒劑，防止耐藥性微生物產生（Resistance Development）
blocks.en: Disinfectant rotation - periodically alternate two or more disinfectants with different chemical mechanisms to prevent the development of resistant microorganisms

blocks.zh: 定期施用孢子殺菌劑——通常每月或每季一次，或在環境監測（EM）趨勢出現異常時觸發
blocks.en: Periodic sporicide use - usually monthly or quarterly, or triggered when environmental monitoring (EM) trends show an anomaly

blocks.zh: 拖把系統——可使用，但拖布頭需為一次性或依計畫滅菌/洗滌
blocks.en: Mop systems - may be used, but mop heads must be disposable or laundered/sterilized according to a plan

blocks.zh: 抹布——無需滅菌，但須低落絮（Low-lint）且與所用藥劑相容
blocks.en: Wipers - need not be sterile, but must be low-lint and compatible with the agents used

blocks.zh: 消毒劑輪替的科學依據
blocks.en: Scientific basis for disinfectant rotation

blocks.zh: 長期使用單一消毒劑，環境中的耐受性微生物株（Tolerant Strains）可能逐漸累積。輪替使用不同作用機制的藥劑（如氧化劑 vs. 界面活性劑），可有效防止此現象，是 EU GMP 和 FDA 指南的共識要求。
blocks.en: With long-term use of a single disinfectant, tolerant strains in the environment may gradually accumulate. Rotating agents with different modes of action (for example, an oxidizing agent vs. a surfactant) effectively prevents this; it is a consensus requirement of EU GMP and FDA guidance.

blocks.zh: Grade D — 一般支援區域
blocks.en: Grade D - general support area

blocks.zh: Grade D 包括：包裝室、容器滅菌前暫存區、更衣前室、物料傳遞走廊等。此等級的主要目標是維持基本的生物負荷控制，防止污染源進入高等級區域。
blocks.en: Grade D includes packaging rooms, holding areas for containers before sterilization, gowning anterooms, material transfer corridors and similar areas. The main objective at this grade is to maintain basic bioburden control and prevent contamination sources from entering higher-grade areas.

blocks.zh: 一般消毒劑（Sanitizer）即可滿足日常需求，但仍需書面 SOP 規定頻率與方法。
blocks.en: A general sanitizer is sufficient for routine needs, but a written SOP specifying frequency and method is still required.

blocks.zh: 四個等級清潔要求比較
blocks.en: Comparison of Cleaning Requirements Across the Four Grades

blocks.zh: 施藥方式說明
blocks.en: Application Methods

blocks.zh: 三種主要施藥方式
blocks.en: Three main application methods

blocks.zh: 噴霧擦拭法（Spray-and-wipe）——最普遍，適用於牆面、設備外表面、工作台面
blocks.en: Spray-and-wipe - the most common; suitable for walls, external equipment surfaces and work surfaces

blocks.zh: 拖把法（Mop）——用於地板，各等級均適用但規格要求不同
blocks.en: Mop - used for floors; applicable to all grades, but specifications differ

blocks.zh: 浸泡法（Soak / Immersion）——適用於小型器具、零件，需完全浸沒
blocks.en: Soak / immersion - suitable for small tools and parts; they must be completely submerged

blocks.zh: 單向重疊擦拭技術（Unidirectional Overlapping Stroke）——最關鍵的操作細節
blocks.en: Unidirectional overlapping stroke technique - the most critical operating detail

blocks.zh: 隨意的「來回擦拭」會將微生物從污染區帶回已清潔區，反而擴散污染。正確方式：
blocks.en: Random "back-and-forth wiping" carries microorganisms from contaminated areas back into cleaned areas and spreads contamination instead. The correct method:

blocks.zh: 抹布從最高風險或最乾淨區域開始（Grade A 灌裝區入口優先）
blocks.en: Start wiping from the highest-risk or cleanest area (the entrance of the Grade A filling zone first)

blocks.zh: 每次擦拭為同一方向（如從左到右或從上到下）
blocks.en: Wipe in the same direction every time (for example, left to right or top to bottom)

blocks.zh: 每次新的擦拭行程重疊前一行程約 30%
blocks.en: Overlap each new stroke with the previous one by about 30%

blocks.zh: 到達邊界後，翻轉或更換抹布，禁止反向重擦
blocks.en: On reaching a boundary, fold over or change the wiper; re-wiping in the reverse direction is prohibited

blocks.zh: 每個區域或每定義擦拭次數後丟棄抹布
blocks.en: Discard the wiper after each area or after a defined number of strokes

blocks.zh: 比喻：粉刷牆面
blocks.en: Analogy: painting a wall

blocks.zh: 好的粉刷技師會用重疊的橫向筆觸，由上到下均勻覆蓋，不留縫隙——清潔抹布操作原理完全相同。隨意畫圈或反覆來回，就像用同一支沾了舊漆的刷子，結果只是把污染均勻分散。
blocks.en: A good painter uses overlapping horizontal strokes, covering evenly from top to bottom without leaving gaps - the principle of wiper technique is exactly the same. Wiping in random circles or back and forth is like using one brush loaded with old paint: the result is simply to spread the contamination evenly.

blocks.zh: 清潔程序步驟順序
blocks.en: Sequence of Cleaning Procedure Steps

blocks.zh: 穿戴符合等級要求的防護裝備（PPE / Gowning）
blocks.en: Don protective equipment appropriate to the grade (PPE / gowning)

blocks.zh: 移除可動設備或物件，擴大清潔可及範圍
blocks.en: Remove movable equipment or objects to extend the reachable cleaning area

blocks.zh: 初步清掃（Initial Cleaning）——去除可見灰塵、碎屑、產品殘跡（此步驟使用清潔劑，非消毒劑）
blocks.en: Initial cleaning - remove visible dust, debris and product residues (this step uses a cleaning agent, not a disinfectant)

blocks.zh: 施用消毒劑（Disinfectant）——噴霧覆蓋，確保全面濕潤，計時維持接觸時間
blocks.en: Apply the disinfectant - spray to ensure full wetting, and time the contact period

blocks.zh: 按 SOP 規定決定是否擦拭或讓藥劑自然揮發
blocks.en: Wipe or allow the agent to evaporate naturally, as specified in the SOP

blocks.zh: 依計畫施用孢子殺菌劑（Sporicide）——視等級頻率而定
blocks.en: Apply the sporicide according to the plan, depending on the frequency for the grade

blocks.zh: 清潔後環境監測（Post-cleaning EM）——確認清潔效果
blocks.en: Post-cleaning EM - confirm the effectiveness of cleaning

blocks.zh: 記錄並簽署清潔日誌（Cleaning Log）
blocks.en: Record and sign the cleaning log

blocks.zh: SOP 必備要素（稽核核查清單）
blocks.en: Essential SOP Elements (Audit Checklist)

blocks.zh: 藥劑名稱與製造商
blocks.en: Agent name and manufacturer

blocks.zh: 使用濃度（配製比例）
blocks.en: Use concentration (dilution ratio)

blocks.zh: 接觸時間（Contact Time）
blocks.en: Contact time

blocks.zh: 抹布類型與規格（是否需要滅菌）
blocks.en: Wiper type and specification (whether sterilization is required)

blocks.zh: 清潔順序（由高等級到低等級，由上到下）
blocks.en: Cleaning sequence (from higher grade to lower grade, from top to bottom)

blocks.zh: 拖把頭更換 / 滅菌頻率
blocks.en: Mop head replacement / sterilization frequency

blocks.zh: 操作人員資格要求
blocks.en: Operator qualification requirements

blocks.zh: 廢棄物處置方式
blocks.en: Waste disposal method

blocks.zh: 本節重點整理
blocks.en: Key Takeaways of This Section

blocks.zh: 三類藥劑的根本差異
blocks.en: Fundamental differences among the three types of agents

blocks.zh: 消毒劑（Sanitizer）——降低微生物數量至安全水準，不能殺滅孢子，適用 Grade D
blocks.en: Sanitizer - reduces microbial counts to a safe level; cannot kill spores; suitable for Grade D

blocks.zh: 消毒劑（Disinfectant）——殺滅多數致病菌（包括病毒），但對孢子效果有限，適用 Grade C/B（輪替使用）
blocks.en: Disinfectant - kills most pathogenic bacteria (including viruses) but has limited effect on spores; suitable for Grade C/B (used in rotation)

blocks.zh: 孢子殺菌劑（Sporicide）——可殺滅細菌孢子與真菌孢子，為 Grade A/B 最高風險區的必備武器
blocks.en: Sporicide - kills bacterial and fungal spores; an essential tool for the highest-risk Grade A/B areas

blocks.zh: 自我測試問題
blocks.en: Self-Assessment Questions

blocks.zh: 你的設施 Grade A 區域 SOP 中，孢子殺菌劑的施用頻率是否有明確規定？
blocks.en: Does your facility's Grade A SOP clearly specify the frequency of sporicide application?

blocks.zh: Grade B 的拖把頭是否與 Grade C 嚴格分開？是否有獨立的滅菌記錄？
blocks.en: Are Grade B mop heads strictly segregated from Grade C ones? Is there a separate sterilization record?

blocks.zh: Grade C 的消毒劑輪替計畫是否記錄在書面程序中，並有實際執行的日誌？
blocks.en: Is the Grade C disinfectant rotation plan documented in a written procedure, with a log showing it is actually carried out?

blocks.zh: 清潔 SOP 是否包含「接觸時間」的要求，並考慮 UDAF 氣流對乾燥速度的影響？
blocks.en: Does the cleaning SOP include a "contact time" requirement that takes into account the effect of UDAF airflow on drying speed?

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用視角：TWi 無菌灌裝
blocks.en: CDMO Application Perspective: TWi Aseptic Filling

blocks.zh: TWi 的灌裝線屬 Grade A/B 環境，對應最嚴格的清潔要求。關鍵管控點：
blocks.en: TWi's filling lines operate in a Grade A/B environment, which corresponds to the most stringent cleaning requirements. Key control points:

blocks.zh: 每次批次生產後，Grade A 區域需完成完整的孢子殺菌劑程序
blocks.en: After each production batch, the Grade A area must complete a full sporicide procedure

blocks.zh: 清潔後的環境監測（Post-cleaning EM）數據需納入批次記錄
blocks.en: Post-cleaning EM data must be included in the batch record

blocks.zh: 藥劑供應商異動（如更換 VHP 系統品牌）需重新驗證效力
blocks.en: A change of agent supplier (for example, changing the brand of VHP system) requires re-validation of efficacy

blocks.zh: FDA/PMDA/EMA 稽核時，查驗清潔日誌與 EM 趨勢圖是標準程序
blocks.en: Review of cleaning logs and EM trend charts is standard procedure during FDA/PMDA/EMA audits

blocks.zh: 本節連結下一部分（Section 4b）
blocks.en: Link to the Next Part (Section 4b)

blocks.zh: Section 4a 涵蓋依區域等級的清潔策略選擇。Section 4b 將深入探討：表面材質對清潔效果的影響（不鏽鋼、環氧樹脂地板、矽膠墊片）、殘留物測試（Residue Testing）、以及特殊情境下的清潔驗證（Cleaning Validation）。
blocks.en: Section 4a covered the selection of cleaning strategy by area grade. Section 4b will go deeper into: the effect of surface material on cleaning effectiveness (stainless steel, epoxy resin flooring, silicone gaskets), residue testing, and cleaning validation in special situations.
